name: CVE-2026-1580-nginx-ingress-auth-method-config-injection
description: CVE-2026-1580 is a critical vulnerability in ingress-nginx controller that allows attackers to inject nginx configuration via the nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-method annotation, leading to arbitrary code execution and disclosure of Secrets.
remediation: Upgrade ingress-nginx to v1.13.7, v1.14.3, or newer versions. Alternatively, deploy a validating admission controller to reject Ingress resources using the nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-method annotation.
test: The control checks for vulnerable versions of ingress-nginx controller (all versions prior to v1.13.7, and v1.14.0 through v1.14.2).
long_description: CVE-2026-1580 is a critical security flaw affecting ingress-nginx with a CVSS v3.1 score of 8.8. The vulnerability allows attackers to exploit the nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-method annotation in Kubernetes Ingress resources to inject nginx configuration. This can lead to arbitrary code execution in the context of the ingress-nginx controller and disclosure of Secrets accessible to the controller. In default configurations, the ingress-nginx controller has cluster-wide Secret access, making the potential impact severe. The vulnerability affects all versions prior to v1.13.7 and versions v1.14.0 through v1.14.2.
